SOUTH AFRICA IS BLOCKING ELON MUSK — AND CONTINUING RACISM

The South African government just denied Elon Musk’s application to visit the country for the first time in years.

This is the same government that has been openly pushing “Expropriation Without Compensation” (seizing land without paying the owners), has presided over record farm murders (disproportionately targeting white farmers), and has repeatedly attacked Elon personally while praising policies rooted in racial discrimination.

Elon, who was born and raised in South Africa, has called out the country’s slide into corruption, violence, and race-based policies for years. Instead of addressing real issues like crime, failing infrastructure, and economic collapse, the ANC-led government chooses to demonize one of its most successful sons.
This isn’t about “justice.”
It’s about maintaining racial resentment and punishing success that doesn’t fit the narrative.
South Africa had a chance to build a non-racial, prosperous democracy after apartheid. Instead, it’s doubling down on the opposite — race-based policies, corruption, and now blocking its own citizens from returning.
Elon’s success is proof that talent and hard work can overcome almost anything. The fact that South Africa is actively blocking him says everything about how far the country has fallen.

Starship is humanity’s vehicle to Kardashev Type II — a civilization that harnesses the full energy output of the Sun (~3.8 × 10²⁶ watts).

We’re stuck at ~Type 0.7, limited to planetary scraps.

Starship’s full reusability and massive payload enable the launch cadence and tonnage needed for orbital solar arrays, space-based power satellites, and the first steps toward a Dyson swarm.

Without cheap, rapid access to orbit, stellar-scale energy stays sci-fi. 

With Starship, it becomes engineering reality — powering unlimited clean energy, AI, industry, and multi-planetary life.

The ship that gets us there is already flying
